Enter pairing code
Paste a code copied from another device to pair without a camera
On the other device, open Show pairing code and choose Copy pairing code. Paste the complete code here within five minutes. Keep the other device’s pairing screen open.
For Waydroid, copy the phone’s code into Waydroid, then start Sync now there. Both devices still need a reachable local-network connection.
Pairing code
